description: A PostHog identity provider configuration: SAML, OIDC, SCIM or ID-JAG (XAA) settings for an organization, applied to all or selected organization domains.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

OrganizationId.description: ID (UUID) of the PostHog organization the configuration belongs to.

Id.description: The PostHog identity provider configuration ID (UUID).

Name.description: Display name for this configuration, e.g. Okta production.

DomainScope.description: Domains this configuration applies to: all organization domains, or the domains in OrganizationDomainIds (selected). Unset behaves like selected.

ConfigScope.description: Feature configured by this configuration: saml, oidc, scim or xaa.

OrganizationDomainIds.description: IDs of the organization domains (PostHog::Organizations::Domain Id) this configuration applies to.

OidcIssuerUrl.description: OIDC HTTPS issuer URL. Must exactly match the issuer in the OIDC discovery document.

OidcClientId.description: Client ID of the organization's OIDC application.

OidcClientSecret.description: OIDC client secret. Write-only: never returned. Removing it from the template removes the saved secret. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}.

SamlAcsUrl.description: SAML single sign-on URL the IdP redirects to.

SamlX509Cert.description: SAML IdP X.509 signing certificate (PEM). Write-only: never read back.

ScimEnabled.description: Whether SCIM provisioning is enabled. Enabling it generates a bearer token, which is written to ScimBearerTokenSecretArn; disabling it clears the token.

ScimBearerTokenSecretArn.description: ARN (or name) of an existing AWS Secrets Manager secret. When SCIM is enabled, PostHog returns the SCIM bearer token once and the handler writes it to this secret as a new version. Required when ScimEnabled is true.

IdJagIssuerUrl.description: Trusted IdP issuer URL for ID-JAG (XAA). Required to enable ID-JAG.

IdJagJwksUrl.description: Override JWKS URL for ID-JAG. Defaults to OIDC discovery on the issuer URL.

IdJagAllowedClients.description: Allowed ID-JAG client IDs. Empty allows any client ID.

SamlRelayState.description: Stable UUID sent as SAML RelayState to route authentication responses to this configuration.

ScimBaseUrl.description: SCIM base URL for this configuration.

HasOidc.description: Whether OIDC has an issuer, client ID and client secret.

HasOidcClientSecret.description: Whether an OIDC client secret is saved.

HasScim.description: Whether SCIM is enabled and a bearer token is set.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
